# Avocado Signal

Avocado Signal is an independent UK web design studio run by Ivan Langton.

It creates clear, lightweight websites, logo identities and local-search foundations for small businesses, sole traders and trades. Its intended market includes Somerset and businesses across the United Kingdom.

## Core services

- Small business web design across the UK
- New small-business websites
- Website redesign and rescue
- Websites for plumbers, heating engineers, electricians, decorators, builders and other trades
- Logo design and business essentials
- Domain connection, static hosting and launch
- Essential technical SEO and Google Business Profile support for eligible local firms

## Public pricing

- One-page website: £495
- Website of up to five pages: £995
- Logo Starter: £295
- Complete Starter Identity: £445
- Optional hosting and care: £180 per year

Full details and optional extras are published at https://avocadosignal.co.uk/pricing
